title: Matched batch and recursive readout study for Gaussian RBF digit classification
status: new controlled experiment, not replication of original reported runs
split: sklearn train_test_split stratified 20000 training from 60000; stratified 5000 validation from remaining 40000 with random_state seed+1000; training order retained
preprocessing: float64 before division by 255; each 28x28 image flattened in MATLAB column order; no other preprocessing
centers: numpy default_rng(seed).choice among training rows without replacement, 100; identical for all settings within seed

sigma_grid.name: scale_025
sigma_grid.rule: 0.25 * median(strict upper triangular pairwise center distance) / sqrt(2)

sigma_grid.name: scale_05
sigma_grid.rule: 0.5 * median(strict upper triangular pairwise center distance) / sqrt(2)

sigma_grid.name: scale_1
sigma_grid.rule: 1.0 * median(strict upper triangular pairwise center distance) / sqrt(2)

lambda_zero: SVD pseudoinverse with cutoff max(N,K)*machine_epsilon*max singular value
ridge: SVD filtered least squares with filter s/(s*s+lambda); unpenalized bias absent
selection: highest integer validation correct count; exact ties choose earliest sigma then earliest lambda in predeclared order
rls_verification: all six positive lambda values at fixed sigma 1 plus selected sigma and selected positive lambda (lambda 1 if selected lambda 0); de-duplicate coincident conditions; P0=(1/lambda)*I, W0=0, single sample pass, no forgetting
timing: perf_counter; 1 BLAS thread; feature construction and solver times separate; no repeated benchmark timing claim
uncertainty: sample standard deviation across five seed outcomes; seeds share the test set and overlapping training pools; no claim of independent population samples
baseline: nearest Euclidean prototype using same 100 training prototypes and their class labels; no hyperparameter selection
